description: This file defines the StoreQuery class, which manages saving, loading, and manipulating user-specific search query parameters for modules within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding parameters to queries, saving or clearing queries, and handling date and number formatting conversions.

classes.name: StoreQuery
classes.description: Class responsible for managing user-specific search query storage, retrieval, and formatting within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: addToQuery
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the current query array.

methods.name: SaveQuery
methods.description: Saves the current query parameters to user preferences after performing necessary data formatting and validation.

methods.name: clearQuery
methods.description: Resets the current query and saves the cleared state.

methods.name: loadQuery
methods.description: Loads a stored query for the given name into the current query object.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates the global $_REQUEST and $_GET variables with the current query data, formatted for display.

methods.name: getSaveType
methods.description: Determines how the query should be saved based on configuration (e.g., 'all', 'myitems', 'populate_only').

methods.name: saveFromRequest
methods.description: Saves the current request data as a query, or clears it based on request parameters.

methods.name: saveFromGet
methods.description: Saves data from $_GET into the query storage, or clears it.

methods.name: getStoredQueryForUser
methods.description: Static method retrieving stored query parameters for a specific module from user preferences.
